description.value:
Requirements You are overflowing.

Lashing forward, your weapon becomes an extension of your nexus, washing your enemies in a torrent of magical fury. Make a melee Strike. Regardless of the result, you create a @Template[type:cone|distance:30] of magical energy dealing @Damage[(floor(@actor.level/2))d6[force]|options:area-damage] damage with a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell|basic] save against your nexus DC. You choose the cone's direction, but its first square must be a square in the target of your strike's space. A creature that critically fails the save is also knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Prone]. The force damage increases by 1d6 at 8th level and every 2 levels thereafter. You are no longer overflowing.
